# Monastic Staff: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10079/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the slender red-orange and gold-banded shaft and compact red-metal open pronged crown cradling one bright cyan-blue faceted orb. Render one complete Monastic Staff on transparent RGBA without an aura or generic redesign..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the slender red-orange and gold-banded shaft and compact red-metal open pronged crown cradling one bright cyan-blue faceted orb. Render one complete Monastic Staff on transparent RGBA without an aura or generic redesign.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10079/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 is paint_mask_guide.png, the exact edit target; image 2 design_reference.png material reference; image 3 icon_x8.png color reference. Preserve the unusual foreshortened views exactly: two tiny end-on objects in row 1 columns 1/2, horizontal object row 1 column 3; horizontal object row 2 column 1, vertical object row 2 column 2, empty column 3. Repeat identical silhouettes for mask rows 3/4. Do not reinterpret views or expand objects to fill cells.
CORRECTIVE GENERATION: The prior attempt widened horizontal silhouettes into full round orb heads and added stray mask speckles. Strictly trace the ORIGINAL grey guide's alpha silhouettes. In horizontal views the head is seen edge-on and is no thicker than the guide: do NOT add a round orb silhouette there. All existing tiny projected details remain exactly as guide. Mask edges must be clean, zero speckles outside. Keep unlit flat base colors without specular bright highlights. Black gem mask regions must be OPAQUE black, not holes. Preserve guide silhouette thickness at every point, and all positions.
